## Changelog

## 🐛 Fixes
**build**
- e246558 Add more details to module descriptor in jreleaser-tool-provider, closes #2175

**changelog**
- 742a5bc Constraint issue number matching regex, closes #2172

**core**
- 3301e9b Resolve recursive templates, closes #2159 #2177
- 4d83050 Use sourced properties to resolve DSL vars, closes #2176

**deploy**
- 99949be Parse POMs without XPath so native-image works

**release**
- 710ab6b Set the git remote to JRELEASER_DEFAULT_GIT_REMOTE, closes #2170

**sftp**
- c26e24c create parent dirs with SFTPClient
